name: chat
title: Chat Card
description: Chat window block built on Message Scroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment and Marker with Standard pieces: an optional header bar, a thread that anchors each new turn and follows streamed replies, a jump-to-latest button, system separators, avatars and author names for group threads, file attachments, a shimmering pending line, copy and regenerate actions on replies, prompt suggestions in the empty state, follow-up chips, bubble-less plain replies for agent transcripts, and a composer that sends on Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line) with a slot for tools such as a model picker or mic. SideChat docks it to a corner as a support widget: a launcher button with an unread count that opens a floating panel with a close button.
